instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Before I add a tool for my space's members, tell me what it would give each member beyond what they already hold, what it reaches or could cost, and whether I must decide it myself", and give it descriptor; members; held.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:show-what-a-tool-would-give-members and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give descriptor (the tool's row: id, placements, needs, price_ref...), toolVersion (the content identity of that definition, so exactly one immutable version is judged), members ([{ member_id, name }]), held ({ member_id: [operations their grants already give] }), and when wanted operations (some of discover, describe, run, read; all when left out) and memberId (one member; * for everyone now and later).
